title: EFC-ΛCDM Comparative Test Specification v1.1
description: Pre-registered, content-hash–locked protocol specifying a three-stage comparative test of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) against ΛCDM on Stage-III cosmic shear data. It defines the EFC phenomenological extensions (µ, Σ), locked gate parameters, priors, scale cuts, and reporting requirements, with pixel-level verification and binding stopping/falsification rules. The specification targets DES Y6 as the primary dataset with KiDS Legacy for cross-pipeline validation using MGCAMB/MGCLASS within Cobaya or CosmoSIS.

gate_function_g_a.description: Late-time transition ("gate") controlling when EFC modifications turn on; parameters a_t=0.7 and \delta a=0.08 are locked.

scale_filter_fk_k.description: Scale filter modulating the k-dependence of perturbations; transition scale locked at k_c = 0.05\,h\,\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}.

mu_ka.description: Modification to the effective Newtonian coupling; free amplitude A_\mu with prior [−0.20, 0.05] (EFC predicts A_\mu < 0).

Sigma_ka.description: Modification to the lensing potential; free amplitude A_\Sigma with prior [−0.05, 0.20] (EFC predicts A_\Sigma > 0).

S8_definition.description: Derived clustering amplitude parameter used for reporting consistency with weak-lensing constraints.

key_results.main_finding: Pre-registered test protocol; no empirical results are reported in this specification.

sealed_predictions.statement: EFC prefers the sign quadrant A_μ < 0 and A_Σ > 0 when confronted with Stage-III cosmic shear data (DES Y6; cross-checked with KiDS Legacy).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DES Y6 fast-scan (grid over A_μ, A_Σ) and full-likelihood MCMC posteriors excluding the A_μ<0, A_Σ>0 quadrant.

sealed_predictions.statement: Setting A_μ = A_Σ = 0 or forcing g(a) → 0 (via a_t ≫ 1 or very small δa) recovers ΛCDM predictions for ξ±, C_ℓ^{\kappa\kappa}, f(z), and σ_8 to within ≤ 0.01% numerical precision.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Pixel-level forward-model verification prior to analysis.

sealed_predictions.statement: Under the VariantH slip constraint (Σ − 1) = − (μ − 1) (α = 1 locked), a one-parameter EFC extension along A_μ ∈ [−0.12, 0.0] yields any improvement localized near the EFC-predicted sign.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: 1D VariantH scan of χ²(A_μ) showing no improvement or preference away from A_μ < 0.

kill_criteria: KC1: Combined DES Y6 and KiDS Legacy posteriors exclude the EFC sign quadrant (A_μ < 0, A_Σ > 0) at high credibility (e.g., the 95% credible region lies entirely outside that quadrant), indicating the phenomenological direction consistent with EFC is disfavored.

KC2: Across both datasets and independent pipelines (Cobaya/MGCAMB and CosmoSIS/MGCLASS), the best-fit EFC extension fails to improve over ΛCDM (Δχ²_best-fit ≥ 0 within numerical tolerance) and the posteriors are consistent with A_μ = 0 and A_Σ = 0, demonstrating no empirical support for EFC-like perturbations.
KC3: VariantH (α = 1) one-parameter test shows no improvement over ΛCDM and prefers A_μ ≈ 0 with uncertainties excluding A_μ < 0 at high credibility, falsifying this EFC variant.

KC4: Pixel-level ΛCDM-recovery check fails (EFC with A_μ = A_Σ = 0 or with g(a) → 0 does not reproduce ΛCDM within ≤ 0.01%): test instance is invalid and all EFC claims under this implementation must be retracted.
